page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.7xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The instance is configured with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include any local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and offering a baseline network bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear performance profile characterized by moderate multi-core capabilities contrasted with weaker single-core execution. The single-core performance is positioned in the bottom 25% across multiple tests, with a Geekbench single-core score of 967.0 and a weak stress-ng single-core CPU score of 1108.99. Conversely, multi-threaded workloads perform in the average tier, as demonstrated by a Geekbench multi-core score of 8400.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 23056.78. Memory bandwidth remains average, reaching 87.55 GB/sec for large block read-only operations, though the Passmark memory score is weak at 1824.58.

The primary tradeoff of the ecs.sn2.7xlarge is its reliance on older-generation CPU architecture, which limits single-threaded efficiency and lacks modern instruction sets like AVX-512 VNNI. However, its dedicated core allocation and balanced resource ratio make it a qualitatively cost-efficient option for multi-threaded workloads that do not require high single-core clock speeds. It is suited for general-purpose applications, multi-threaded software compilation, static web serving, and moderate database operations.
